Dear Dr. Hallquist, Dr. Wiley and colleagues,

I estimated a bunch of LCA models using Mplus.
Using MplusAutomation I wanted to compare these models in regard to their relative fit (amongst others: LL, BIC, AIC, SSBIC, BLRT, VLMR) and sort them by their estimated parameters.
Unfortunately, I was not able to extract a part (see below) of these statistics from the Mplus-outputs.
I recently updated the Mplus-package and before that I was able to extract all the needed information.

Attached is one of the Mplus output files. Below is my code and output from R:

I would be very grateful for any help!

Best regards,
Flo Kaiser

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: LCA: No Extraction of LL, Parameters, BIC, etc from Mplus-Outputs
parts:
Hi Florian,

This has to do with a new feature of the package for extracting model fit info from measurement invariance outputs in Mplus v8... which introduced a new bug since there is a MODEL FIT INFORMATION section under TECH10 in your output. I added a workaround for this section so that your output now reads in properly. You'll need to install the development version of the package to get the fix, as described here: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation

Best,
Michael

On Saturday, July 22, 2017 at 4:58:48 AM UTC-4,

Additional information:
I installed a former version of MplusAutomation (v 6.0) and I was again able to extract the desired information
